distanceSource: The 140 pc distance adopted by ALMA Partnership et al. (2015), Section 1, and Pinte et al. (2016), Section 1. The package uses the published radio position; Gaia astrometry is not used.
radiusSource: Radius 6.906038653092741 solar radii from Model radius derived from Pinte et al. (2016), Section 3.1: adopted stellar effective temperature, a model input (https://doi.org/10.3847/0004-637X/816/1/25). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
